main.description: Marks this account as an organisation. An account without this record is a person.

orgType.description: The kind of organisation, for presentation and discovery: 'company' (formal, work) or 'clan' (community, belonging). Lowercase, digits and dashes only. Compared exactly by consumers — never ordered, never case-folded. Absent means unspecified; the client picks the default presentation. Open set: new kinds (e.g. guild, team) may be added without breaking older records.

enrollment.description: curated = an admin attests each member; open = the org attests anyone who asks.

discoverable.description: Opt-in to the public directory. Absent or false = the org is NOT listed anywhere and only reachable by handle/DID — the default, because nobody ever consented to standing in a directory. Directory listings MUST require this to be exactly true. Marking an org-shaped account as an organisation in search results is independent of this flag: being an org is itself a public record.

inviteOnly.description: When true, the org does not take join requests — membership starts only with an invitation from the org. Absent or false = anyone may apply (the default: an application is a knock on the door, not an imposition). Clients MUST hide their join-request affordance and servers MUST reject join requests while this is true.
